full_page.content:
Page 194 Cont.
Mar. 12 Philip Loist - 25 - missing two weeks yesterday - his car has been found but no trace of him. Wife expecting Ist little baby asks for prayers ..... Enrolled in S. Masses ... 50¢
Page 195
Mar. 12 James Retell - 61 - perenitis - in oxygen .... Mt. Carmel Hosp ....
Thanks ... Denis Marentette - 53 - Nerveous - Home now and hoping to go back to work - prayed recently.
John Martin - 50 - at Providence - pneumonia
Otis Hynes - 45 - sadly inclined to drink - refused to alow daughter to go to convent. ..
March 9 Mrs. Laurentia Vermeersch - 35 - married 13 yrs. - asks for prayers that God bless her with a family ..... Enrolls Today 50c
9 Thanks - Edmond Delworth - 7 - shot through stomach and intestines - 6th - 12 openings in bowels - asked to be prayed for day of accident inscribed % phone - apendix severed .... ! ! ! Accident happened a week To-day, March 9th - Now seemingly out of danger.
Nellie Laskowsk - 26 - Hodgkins disease
seemingly hopeless
Page 196
Mar. 18 Bebe Neeley - 39 -
Joseph St. Louis - 84 - nerveous
19 Genevieve Palace - 35 - T.B. back in San. for two yrs. - discouraged. Sm. Landry - 37 - formerly of Detroit - now NewBrunswick - cancer of stomach.
19 Frank Gehringer - 28 - Epileptic since born .... improved lately.
Flowers for alters ....
20 Jerry O'Malley - about 45 - blood clot - operation last night. Sister phones. Drs. give little hope - Has wife and Fam.
Gertrude Chevalier - about 40 - Waterloo, Iowa - telegram last eve- ning asking .....
